source: Ciphertext-only search followed by internal linguistic inference and image checking, 23 September 2026. This is not a historical key document.

open_codes.D: Four occurrences. Cardinal Wolsey is the likely referent, inferred from context, not a recovered expansion.
open_codes.Q: Two occurrences, after per and havera. A pronoun or title is possible; no expansion established.
open_codes.S2: One occurrence after questo in the opening. A royal title is plausible, but segmentation and exact expansion remain unverified.

emendations.reason: 9 without secure dot in magesta; restore 9d by context.

Stray dot on S in rebatuti; not silently changed to restituti.

uncertainty_notes.3:18: Extra straight stroke yields parutite. Partite is likely, but no deletion is counted as read.
uncertainty_notes.5:12-13 and 8:15-16: Literal so before D may be an abbreviated title or reference word. No expansion is asserted.
uncertainty_notes.14:1-4: Literal dese; ten is an attested regional meaning, but its attachment to the adjacent clear numerical notation is not secure. These four letters are assigned but conservatively excluded from coherent coverage.
